allowed_sentences: On P168's 38 case-orders, 5 had an activity or heat total outside 1e-06 of the reference at some step under the status quo.
Candidate A brought 3 of those 5 within 1e-06 of the reference or inside its reported bound.
Candidate B brought 3 of those 5 within 1e-06 of the reference or inside its reported bound.
Candidate C brought 3 of those 5 within 1e-06 of the reference or inside its reported bound.

On the 16 held-out case-orders (140 scored steps, 17 with a below-floor state under the status quo) the bound problems were 20 for A, 26 for B and 26 for C; B re-solved 12 steps at CRAM-48 and C reconstructed 7 states, at a largest wall-time ratio of 1.01 against the status quo.
No candidate met the decision rule (A G2, A G3, B G3, C G3); below-floor states stay in the totals, flagged by n_states_below_floor, and the finding is documented in data-limits.
